claims.text: Media reports in October 2016 revealed Choi Soon-sil's influence over President Park Geun-hye
The National Assembly voted to impeach Park Geun-hye on December 9, 2016
The Constitutional Court upheld the impeachment and removed Park from office on March 10, 2017
Park was arrested and detained on March 31, 2017
Park was convicted on multiple corruption charges on April 6, 2018

outcome.summary: Park Geun-hye was impeached by the National Assembly in December 2016 and removed from office by the Constitutional Court on March 10, 2017. She was arrested and later convicted on multiple corruption charges, receiving a 24-year prison sentence (later reduced). The scandal led to the election of Moon Jae-in as her successor.

title: Park Geun-hye impeachment and removal
trigger: Park Geun-hye was impeached and removed from office after a corruption scandal involving her close confidante Choi Soon-sil, who was accused of extorting companies and influencing state affairs through her personal relationship with the president.
